- 6 New stat seal tiers added. 
- Level cap raised to 666.
- General bug fixes & improvements

notes.title: Patch Update - Ver 1.9.8
notes.notes:
We've patched the game to ver. 1.9.8. Here are the latest additions and fixes:

- Added an updated pause menu back into the game. Quitting is allowed during gameplay in Friend Play, but not World Play. This is to reduce player rage quitting during public matches. 

- Stale session fix for World Play. The fix gives a better chance to join matches, because it joins best ping sessions first. This greatly reduces getting kicked back to the main menu for "network errors" or "unknown reason".

- Fixed broken boss pathing in all base game & DLC maps. This includes characters with an ultimate ability that uses pathing (example - Silent Hill's Robbie the Rabbit). 

- Blood moon sky has been added to the Coma 2: Vicious Sisters DLC. Whenever Boss Time triggers, the sky will change to a blood moon as the Butcher begins his hunt. 

- Buffed the Butcher in The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters DLC. He is now more aggressive and does more damage.

notes.title: Dedicated Server Private Beta
notes.notes:
For those who were sent the password to the dedicated server beta, it is now up. It requires there be 6 players to a server, so if there aren't enough people on at a time, uhhh, I won't snitch if you share the password lol.

As of now, there are only 10 servers available (all of which on the World Play, private matches aren't on the dedicated servers yet), but 10 * 6 = 60 so that shouldn't be a problem I'd imagine. However, whenever you first start matchmaking, you may get an error that says something like "FleetExceededCapacity in CreateGameSession," if you get that error message, feel free to ignore it. If you get some other kind of error message, lmk on [url=https://twitter.com/cromwellslimon]https://twitter.com/cromwellslimon[/url], but that should be the only error message. The reason why that pops up is just because it's trying to start up a new instance of the dedicated server but it can take like 20 seconds, I have the matchmaking button set to retry on a loop every 10 seconds so if you click "World Play" and then just wait a bit, you'll join a match eventually, if not basically immediately.

Also, we haven't sorted out balancing yet so [url=https://twitter.com/cromwellslimon]feel free to leave feedback to me [/url] and I'll relay that to Vince or something, I don't mess with balancing, I'm just the [url=https://twitter.com/GlowstickEntmt/status/1461318703916609539][i]software engineer[/i][/url] (ooo, fancy title)

Have fun gaming, gamers
- Simon Cromwell

notes.title: The Silent Hill DLC is Launching on March 23rd! Wishlist it NOW!
notes.notes:
Monsters & Mortals - Silent Hill DLC officially launches on March 23rd at 6AM PST! Buy it during the launch week to get the 10% launch discount. This DLC is available for a LIMITED TIME ONLY!

It's highly unusual for a small indie team like Glowstick Entertainment to obtain an IP as big as Silent Hill. We are extremely proud to have worked on it and we owe the opportunity to the success of Dark Deception and the passion of the DD community! That said, this is a huge test for the Monsters & Mortals community. If the Silent Hill DLC sells well, DLC for other big AAA IP become a strong possibility. We definitely cannot do it without your help. So if you own Monsters & Mortals, but are on on the fence as to which DLC to buy, this is definitely the one to get. Wishlist the game now and help spread the word! Get ready for Heather, Cybil, Robbie, Nurse, and Red Pyramid Thing to join the madness! 

We'll see you in Silent Hill on March 23rd!

notes.title: Elementary Evil Update (And More)!
notes.notes:
Great news - it's update time! There's a ton of new content in this update to share with you all! Here's a quick breakdown of what's new in the Elementary Evil Update:

- The store is now active. Spend your shards & red shards in the store to unlock Extras items and new skins. 

- Elementary Evil map is now playable, featuring a new type of trap, a new boss, and new music!
- 21 new skins (total) for existing mortal & monster characters! Unlock them in the store!
- Soul Collection mode has been added! Compete against 4 mortals and collect shards to save your soul from Malak. Each shard wave, Malak will come for the mortal with the fewest shards. In the end, only one mortal gets to keep their soul. Will it be you? The others will be turned into mindless monsters!

- New additions to the Extras menu! Now you can see & track your stats as you play matches. Build your stats up to unlock higher stat tiers! There is also an art gallery where you can check out art purchased from the store!

- New leveling system! Those wins count for more than just red shards now. Accumulate wins in order to level up and gain new rewards!
- UI/UX improvements! A bit more uniformity in the menu system. 
- Major & minor bug fixes.

Enjoy the new update and get ready for the Monstrum DLC (which is coming up next) :)!

notes.title: 1.1.5 Update
notes.notes:
We have updated the game with some nice quality of life features and bug fixes.

Make sure to restart Steam if you do not receive the update. 


[h2][b]Changelog:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] We have added an information feed widget that should keep all players up to date with important information throughout the match. (kills, respawns, ragequitters etc.) 

[*] Monsters in Maze Escape will now always see mortals through walls. 

[*] Mortals in Maze Escape will now always see other mortals through walls.

[*] Ghosts will now see everyone through walls.

[*] Shortly after spawning, the player will be invulnerable to all damage for a few seconds.

[*] Kills made by the Clown Gremlin Clones will now count towards the player who spawned them. 

[*] The Clown Gremlin Clones are now able to be killed in 5 hits. 

[*] Chef Monkeys will not block the player anymore.

[*] Total length of Maze Escape has been shortened 8 > 7 minutes.

[*] The Mortal Team in Maze Escape will lose up to 25 shards every time they die (from 15)

[*] And other small bug fixes. 

[/list]

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Monstrum DLC is Coming Next!
notes.notes:
We hope you are enjoying Monsters & Mortals so far! As with all new multiplayer games, this is simply the starting point of the experience - the most barebones version of the game. From here on out, we will be constantly improving the game, fixing bugs, adding new characters, adding new modes, adding new maps, and more! As the months go by, the game will become bigger & bigger with your support!

November brings our first guest DLC to Monsters & Mortals: Monstrum. Monstrum will add 1 new mortal character (prisoner) & 2 new monster characters (Fiend & Brute), a new map (Hisa Maru cargo ship), new music, and a new boss. 

We will also keep adding additional Dark Deception content to the base game. We are planning to add the Elementary Evil map before the end of 2020! We will also add a new gameplay mode before the end of 2020! So sit back and enjoy the ride. We are going to give you a lot of bang for your buck before it's all said and done and we will do our best to make the game even more fun!

notes.title: Monsters & Mortals is RELEASED!
notes.notes: We fixed some last minute bugs and now it's up! Buy it now to get 10% OFF! Thanks for your patience & support!

notes.title: Monsters & Mortals is launching today!
notes.notes: Good news! Valve has approved the launch build of Monsters & Mortals! On the plus side, we used the extra time to get all 3 Glowstick Entertainment team characters in, so now the game will launch with 12 characters instead of 10. We are going to run a few more final tests, but the game will definitely launch today!

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.notes: Our submitted launch build to Valve has not been approved yet, so we may not be able to release today as planned. We are waiting for Valve's response. Keep your fingers crossed! We will keep you all updated if anything changes in the short term. Things don't always go according to plan, so thank you for your patience. The game is done & ready to play. We just need to get it out of the garage and onto the store.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes: Good news everyone! After much consideration, we've decided to make the Dark Deception: Monsters & Mortals Beta Test an open beta instead of a private one! That means that everyone can play and all you have to do is download the demo that we put up on the Steam page on the 16th (at 1:00PM PST). Anyone that submitted their email & Steam ID info to our landing page does not need to worry - the information will be deleted. You will not be signed up for any mailing list or anything like that. We'd definitely appreciate if you all wishlist and follow the game on Steam instead :)!
